title: US move to curb Chinese optical gear, potentially benefiting Korean suppliers
html: The Trump administration is moving ahead with plans to restrict Chinese optical transceivers used in US data centers, potentially creating opportunities for South Korean suppliers even as major technology companies warn that the move could disrupt AI...
